sources.title: About responsive search ads
sources.source_date_note: No explicit publication/update date observed; checked on the date above
sources.section: How it works; Create a responsive search ad
sources.derived_not_quoted: An entirely double-width headline can contain at most 15 characters; an entirely double-width description at most 45. Mixed text requires a weighted count, not raw character length.
sources.limits: No platform validation or linguistic certification performed; exact mixed Unicode treatment and final acceptance must be checked in the native ad editor.

sources.title: Create responsive search ads
sources.verified: At least 3 and at most 15 unique headlines, at least 2 and at most 4 unique descriptions, at least one final URL; headline30/description90/path15 limits corroborated.

sources.title: Codes and formats
sources.limits: These historical language codes are reference data. Manual criteria are unavailable for Search campaigns under GOOGLE-LANG-02. No country geo IDs were researched or invented.

sources.title: Google Ads language targeting changes starting September 2026
sources.verified: The campaign-level language setting was removed from Search campaigns in late September 2026. Existing criteria may still appear in API queries but do not control delivery. Match signals include ad and destination language and user language preferences.

sources.title: Tell Google about localized versions of your page
sources.verified: Google maps zh-TW for users in Taiwan to Chinese-Traditional; zh-Hant explicitly denotes Traditional Chinese.
sources.limits: Search locale annotation supports localization design; it is not Ads policy approval or evidence of brokerage authority.

sources.title: Other restricted businesses
sources.verified: Google pauses ads serving users located in Russia and pauses ads on Google properties and networks globally for advertisers based in Russia.
sources.limits: No lifting date was stated. Russian-language support is distinct from Russia geography; this does not prohibit Russian language in an otherwise eligible geography.

sources.title: Housing in personalized advertising
sources.section: Targeting guidelines for Access to opportunities categories
sources.verified: The specified housing targeting restrictions cover the US and Canada and prohibit targeting using gender, age, parental status, marital status and ZIP codes there.
sources.limits: This particular policy does not establish a Germany, France or Taiwan ban or legal clearance. No inference is made that all other targeting is acceptable.

sources.title: Resources to help you get ready for privacy and regulatory changes for traffic in the European Economic Area
sources.verified: For applicable tags or SDKs sending data to Google, EEA users' personal-data consent and consent signals are required for the described measurement, personalization and remarketing use cases; this also covers Analytics data used in Ads.
sources.limits: Germany and France are within this EEA context. This source does not certify any existing consent implementation.

sources.title: Update to the legal requirements policy (September 2026)
sources.verified: Advertisers must comply with local laws in locations their ads target as well as Google policies.

sources.title: 不動產經紀業從事國外不動產仲介或代銷業務規範
sources.english_title_for_reference: Guidelines for real estate brokers conducting foreign-property brokerage or agency sales
sources.source_date_kind: Issuance corroborated by Ministry business report; not an asserted last amendment date
sources.section: Section2, marketing and advertising, PDF page2
sources.verified: For the brokers covered by the guidance: sales authorization before advertising; Chinese ads identifying the broker and signed by a broker; substantiation for numerical claims; a prominent overseas-property investment risk warning; for presales, developer operating permission and development approval documents with Chinese translations.
sources.limits: Public guideline text was verified, but territorial applicability, required operating arrangement, compliance of any BSRE ad and current legal authorization were not determined. Do not infer a mandatory local partner, licence exemption, or launch clearance from this research.

sources.title: 不動產經紀業管理條例
sources.publisher: Taiwan Ministry of Justice Laws and Regulations Database
sources.source_date_kind: Amendment date displayed by current official statute page
sources.verified: Covered brokerage operators require authority permission and registration; foreign-property brokerage or agency sales are limited to company-form registration.
sources.limits: This is a bounded statute reading, not legal advice, a territorial-scope determination or evidence of BSRE permission.
